titleNative: 放課後、僕らは宇宙に惑う
synonyms: After School, We Wander in Space.
synopsis: Kinoshima Rocketry Club casually uploaded a vlog of a test firing of their hybrid engine. The engine exploded — blowing away their dream of reaching space with it — but that wasn't the only thing that blew up in that video. Ayame Madoi, a girl who worked on the engine section who happened to appear in the vlog, also exploded in popularity when viewers from across the world found her cute. While she finds this attention bewildering, she actually already has someone she wishes would notice her that way… (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Onmyouji
synopsis: Must we believe in ancient legends? In mythical tales and characters? As a child, Abe-no-Seimei in the company of his master Kamo Tadayuki walks his first steps on the paths frequented by evil spirits and angry souls of darkness with a thousand spells. Seimei, who can feel an evil entity approaching before anyone else, is taken in by Tadayuki, who sees in him an exceptional talent for the practices of Yin and Yang. From that day on, Seimei was made his disciple and was taught all his secrets.

title: NINE PEAKS
synopsis: Gaku Mashio was a first-year high school student who lived with his father. He lost his father in a sudden accident, just as he got suspended from school after getting into a fight. On the night of his father's wake, Gaku went fishing on the shore in memory of his father, but he fell into the sea and was returned 22 years into the past. Gaku's father, Harumi, who was the same age as Gaku at that time, saved him from the water. Harumi's parents (Gaku's grandparents) took a liking to Gaku, and accepted him into their family under the name Gaku Miyagi. His grandparents even encouraged him to go to Seiha High School, same as his father. Twenty-two years ago, the town of Kurei was full of delinquents. Now Gaku and his father will fight their way to the top of the town! (Source: Shonen Champion, translated)

synopsis: When the Players from beyond the stars turned the peaceful Blue Star into their personal slaughterhouse, all hope seemed lost. But the system made a fatal error, unlocking the ultimate hidden class for Lin Yuan: the Necro Hunter. He's the glitch they never saw coming—an NPC who came back from death with the power to hunt the mighty Players. The game for Blue Star's survival is about to be rewritten, and he's leading the charge with vengeance. (Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: The Only One Who Knows How to Make Her Fall for Me Is the Future Me Who Marries Her
synopsis: Q: Why did you choose this high school? A: Because my future wife is enrolling here. When I woke up, I had time-leaped 15 years into the past. Standing before me was Arisugawa Yuki, my future wife, wearing a school uniform I don't recognize. In the original timeline, we wouldn't meet until we became adults and eventually got married, so we're still strangers for now. But I know that she distrusts people, has no friends, and spends her school days alone. I also know she'll deeply regret that time in the future. So this time, I'm going to rewrite her youth. "How do you know my secret!?" "Because we're husband and wife... in the future." (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shippo to Gekirin
synopsis: Aki Miyama is a beastkin who has lived a quiet, unassuming life, blending in seamlessly among humans. Then, one day—quite out of the blue—a beastkin child named Tsukiko suddenly tumbles into his life! Thus begins a shared existence born of a chance encounter between two polar opposites: a socially awkward adult and a guileless, earnest child. Together, they make a home—striving to survive in a world that was never built for the likes of them. (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

titleNative: お嬢様系底辺ダンジョン配信者、迷惑系をボコったらバズって伝説になってますわ！？
synopsis: The original story is set a few years after dungeons began appearing in the modern world. Karin Yamada is a "dungeon streamer," a new kind of streamer who live streams their expeditions in the dungeon. Though she has adopted the character of a classy rich lady, with zero views and three subscribers, she is decidedly obscure, and depressed about it. One day, she stumbles on an adventurer trying to stir up trouble for views by causing an explosion in a dungeon. Karin immediately leaps into action and stops it by beating up the adventurer. Little did she know that the adventurer was also streaming to a wide audience, who all saw her beating up and lecturing the adventurer. The incident propels her to overnight popularity. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: They ridiculed me for my luckless job, but it's not actually that bad?

synonyms: People Looked Down on Me for Having a Crummy Job but It Really Isn't All That Bad?
synopsis: One day, Reito Shirosaki is suddenly sucked into a mysterious fissure and falls through a dimensional rift, only to be reincarnated as a newly-born baby in another world. He was born as the heir to a royal family, but after hearing his father the King shout at him "What the hell is this trash?", he ends up being banished from the castle. The cause for his father's outrage was him being born with the "Alchemist" and "Supporting Magician" job classes, two of the weakest, most luckless jobs in that world, which places him at a disadvantage from birth. However, what great powers lies hidden within his job classes..?! (Source: Alpha Manga)

A sweet and impatient love triangle love comedy where you can't be honest! (Source: Kodansha, translated)
